purpose: Verify PyPI ranking prefers requested-format project names over incidental substring matches.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cd',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
goal='Encode those exact records as BSON and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_RECORDS.bson'
out=m.search_pypi_packages(goal,limit=20,timeout_s=20)
c=out.get('candidates') or []
names=[str(x.get('name') or '') for x in c]
print(json.dumps([{'name':x.get('name'),'score':x.get('score')} for x in c[:15]],sort_keys=True))
assert any(n.lower().startswith('bson') for n in names[:12]),names[:12]
print('PYPI_BSON_FORMAT_RANKING_VERIFIED')
PY
